page.title: Business details
page.ordering_body: Orders are placed on this site at least 24 hours before the delivery or pickup time. Before payment you see the products, the date and time, and the final total.
page.prices_body: The prices shown are final prices. The delivery fee depends on the delivery city and is shown before payment.
page.delivery_body: Deliveries are made by the business's courier to the cities offered at checkout. You can also pick up the order yourself.
page.payment_body: Payment is by Bit or PayBox, through a link shown after you order. Write the order number in the payment note. The order is confirmed once the payment is received.

errors.not_found_body: The page you were looking for does not exist.

exemption_notice.title: Cancelling an order
exemption_notice.catalog: Fresh food product: the order cannot be cancelled after it is confirmed, under the Consumer Protection Law.
exemption_notice.custom_cake: Made especially for you: a custom cake cannot be cancelled after the order is confirmed, under the Consumer Protection Law.
exemption_notice.before_payment: Until you pay, you can still cancel the order: contact us by phone or WhatsApp.
exemption_notice.defects: This does not affect your rights if a product is defective.
